cmd: cd /opt/weather-tg && for f in weather_tg_outlook.py weather_tg_review.py weather_tg_2weeks.py; do curl -sf -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/scripts/$f -o $f.new && mv $f.new $f; done; python3 -m py_compile weather_tg_outlook.py weather_tg_review.py weather_tg_2weeks.py && echo COMPILED_V2; F=/etc/cron.d/weather-tg; sed -i "s|^30 9,10 \* \* 4,5 \(.*weather_tg_review.py weekend.*\)|30 9,10 * * 5 \1|" $F; sed -i "s|^30 6,7 \* \* \* \(.*weather_tg_2weeks.py.*\)|30 6,7 * * 0 \1|" $F; grep -q "weather_tg_review.py rest" $F || printf "30 6,7 * * 3 root cd /opt/weather-tg && PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 /usr/bin/python3 weather_tg_review.py rest >> run.log 2>&1\n30 9,10 * * 4 root cd /opt/weather-tg && PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 /usr/bin/python3 weather_tg_review.py rest >> run.log 2>&1\n" >> $F; grep "review\|2weeks" $F | sed "s| root cd /opt/weather-tg \&\& PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 /usr/bin/python3 | |; s| >> run.log 2>&1||"; echo DRY; timeout 100 python3 weather_tg_2weeks.py --force --dry --no-ai 2>&1 | head -20 | cut -c1-200; echo V2_DONE
